# Trident v0.3.3

Trident v0.3.3 brings standardized and heterogeneous vulnerability evidence
into the same auditable review and triage pipeline as native scanner findings.

## Highlights

- First-class imports for SonarQube, OWASP Dependency-Check, SARIF 2.1.0, and
  CycloneDX vulnerability JSON.
- Bounded generic JSON mapping, explicit `trident-json-mapping-v1` mappings,
  and `trident inspect` for format, mapping, coverage, and accounting review.
- Optional schema-AI mapping proposals that are deterministically validated and
  executed; the model does not create normalized findings.
- Semantic normalization for advisory identifiers, package/version evidence,
  severity, CVSS, and related canonical fields.
- Field-level provenance, report hashes, source grounding, report-only evidence,
  and exact terminal record accounting.
- Imported evidence continues through correlation, Council review, judge and
  cross-examination, red-team attack-chain analysis, guards, triage, and the
  existing table, JSON, SARIF, and triage-sidecar outputs.
- Improved Ollama transport observability and a safer manually gated release
  workflow with reviewed versioned release notes.

This release supersedes the withdrawn v0.3.0 and v0.3.1 releases and the
incomplete v0.3.2 publication.
